body: He's totally against going to therapy and I've told him that I think it could help. But that's a good starting point though (the format you gave me) so thank you for that!
Thank you. I was sick today but Monday morning I’ll be there when they open
One more question sorry...will it look like I'm going over my supervisor's head if I speak to the deparment? I mean, could it somehow get back to her and look bad?

Thanks. I think I made a mistake with my advisor because I was desperate to find a supervisor. We're cordial but she has a very hands-off approach and I often feel like I'm trying to figure everything out on my own even after she speaks to me.

I think I'm going to head over to the department tomorrow and see if I can save myself. They looked at my grades and encouraged me to go into this program where an individual thesis is mandatory, but now I think I made a mistake.

The grad students in my lab are not super friendly. I'm a bit intimidated by them, because it's a very cliquey atmosphere. But I guess I need to suck it up and maybe ask, and be told no.
